Name: DCB's Luo HD Portrait-They Stay With You
Author: DistilledChickenBurger
Description:
I am not a native English speaker and use an English translator. If there is any ambiguity, please feel free to post.

[quote][b][size=5]﻿本模组为《[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30989]They Stay With You 与你同在[/url]﻿》洛的高清肖像，希望大家喜欢！必须下载[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]高清肖像模组Portraiture[/url]﻿才能使用。请不要将图像用于AI、非绘制角色肖像外的其他作用，或者魔改为其他角色。
[/size][size=4]This mod is a HD portrait of Luo from '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30989]They Stay With You[/url]﻿'. I hope you will like it! You must download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]the Portraiture module[/url]﻿ to use it. Please do not use the image for purposes other than AI, non portrait drawing, or modifying it for other characters.
[/size][/b][/quote]


[list]
[*][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Luo7710]@Luo7710[/url]﻿ 前排艾特洛老师，其实“洛”这个角色就是洛老师的自设。
[/list]
[list]
[*]受限于像素图的画幅大小，所以原来模组肖像没有头饰，实际上在设定里是有额饰的，高清肖像的画幅更大，所以我进行了补充。但为了风格的统一性，所以我增加了无头饰的版本，大家可以自由选择。
[*]Due to the limited size of the pixel image, the module portrait does not have a headpiece. In fact, the character has a headpiece, and the high-definition portrait has a larger size, so I have added it. But for the sake of style consistency, I have added versions without decorations, so everyone can freely choose.
[/list]



[size=5][b]【文件内容】[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]洛的肖像（1400*700px png）[/size]
[*][size=2]一共有2张图片，可以根据喜欢的风格选择[/size]
[*][size=2]将你选择好的肖像名字改成“Luo”，然后放入名叫Portraiture的文件夹，再挪入“[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]”模组内[/size]
[*][color=#ea9999][size=2][b]如果不改图片的名字，Portraiture模组会无法识别[/b][/size][/color]
[/list]

[size=5][b]  [File Content][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Portrait of Luo（1400*700px png）[/size]
[*][size=2]There are 2 pictures in total, you can choose according to your favorite style[/size]
[*][size=2]Change the name of your selected portrait to 'Luo', then place it in a folder called Portraiture', and move it into the '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]' module[/size]
[*][color=#ea9999][size=2][b]Without changing the name of the image, the Portrait module will not recognize it.[/b][/size][/color]
[/list]
